name: Class buffs: the Hasten and Combat Symbiosis cooldowns stack on one ally
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 (PR #13237 review): a buff of five minutes or longer keeps one per stat
across classes; a shorter buff whose tooltip says it does not stack with similar effects is a support buff
and keeps one per stat among support buffs; every other shorter buff is a cooldown, has no CoA class
category and stacks with everything. Hasten 801304 (Chronomancer, class 22, 12 seconds:
SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS and SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE, base points 19: 20% each, plus run speed)
and Combat Symbiosis 805305 (Tinker, class 28, 15 seconds: the same two haste auras, base points 19: 20%
each) are cooldowns, so no spell_group decides the pair. Expected: on a grouped ally Combat Symbiosis
leaves Hasten in place. Both have a 90 second cooldown, so neither is cast a second time.
